setup.intro.welcome: Welcome! HA NOVA lets your AI assistant run your Home Assistant.
setup.intro.steps: Steps: pick your AI app, find Home Assistant, add the NOVA App, connect this computer, add the skills.
setup.intro.browser: When a browser page opens, finish there and come back here.
setup.intro.owner: You need the Home Assistant owner's account.
setup.intro.link_only: Home Assistant Link only: the NOVA App must already be installed.
setup.menu.hint: Use ↑/↓ or j/k, Enter to select, Ctrl+C to exit
setup.menu.hint_back: Use ↑/↓ or j/k, Enter to select, Esc to go back, Ctrl+C to exit
setup.menu.invalid_choice: Pick one of the numbers shown.
setup.clients.none_registered: no AI apps to set up
setup.clients.unsupported: HA NOVA doesn't work with this AI app: {client}
setup.clients.question: Which AI app do you use?
setup.clients.none_ready: No AI app found on this computer yet.
setup.clients.install_first: Setup connects this computer to Home Assistant now; at the end it says which AI app to install.
setup.clients.install_first_link: Install one of them first, then run: ha-nova setup
setup.clients.none_after_pairing: One step left: install one of these AI apps: {clients}. Then run: ha-nova setup (it adds HA NOVA to that app).
setup.token.question: How do you want to set up the shared key (Relay Auth Token)?
setup.token.paste: Paste a key from another computer or from Home Assistant
setup.discovery.local_name_fragile: This name can stop working, mostly on Windows. Type its IP address below instead.
setup.discovery.find_ip: Find it in Home Assistant: Settings → System → Network.
setup.discovery.none_saved: Didn't find Home Assistant by itself. Starting from your saved address {host}
setup.discovery.none: Didn't find Home Assistant by itself. Type its address.
setup.done.connected_no_client: This computer is connected to Home Assistant.
setup.codex.where: Codex is the codex command in a terminal, the Codex IDE extension, and Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app (formerly the Codex app). In the app, start a new chat to load HA NOVA.
setup.codex.where_linux: Codex is the codex command in a terminal and the Codex IDE extension. Start a new Codex session to load HA NOVA.
setup.claude.where: Claude Code is the claude command in a terminal and the Code tab in the Claude Desktop app (in a new chat). The chat tab in Claude Desktop doesn't use it. For that tab, see chat apps (needs Home Assistant reachable from the internet).
setup.done.example_light: Turn off the living room light
setup.done.legacy_token:
This computer still uses the old shared access.
The next HA NOVA release won't accept it.
setup.done.legacy_switch: Run ha-nova setup again any time to switch. It takes a minute.
setup.done.connection_away: Away from home: Ready — Home Assistant Link
setup.done.connection_routing: Which one:      Automatic. Home Assistant Link only when home can't be reached
setup.incomplete.title: Setup incomplete
setup.incomplete.ws_degraded: The NOVA App answers, but it isn't connected to Home Assistant yet.
setup.incomplete.ws_degraded_fix: In Home Assistant, open Settings → Apps → NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons). Check its settings, then restart it.
setup.incomplete.relay_unreachable: HA NOVA saved your setup, but couldn't reach the NOVA App yet.
setup.incomplete.relay_unreachable_fix: In Home Assistant, open Settings → Apps → NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons) and start it.
setup.incomplete.skills: This computer is connected to Home Assistant, but HA NOVA isn't set up in your AI app yet.
setup.incomplete.link: HA NOVA works at home, but Home Assistant Link isn't ready yet.
setup.incomplete.link_fix: Run setup again to finish Home Assistant Link.
setup.incomplete.generic: HA NOVA saved your setup, but it isn't ready yet.
setup.incomplete.rerun: Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.
setup.resumed_pairing: Finished connecting this computer. It is connected now.
setup.prompt.open_browser: Press Enter to open your browser
setup.link.unavailable_build: Home Assistant Link doesn't work here: not on this computer, in this terminal, or in this HA NOVA build.
setup.link.paused_stop: Setup needs to change this computer's key, and it won't while Link is unfinished. Choose above, then run ha-nova setup again.
setup.link.terminal: Link isn't finished, so setup runs here in the terminal.
setup.link.terminal_hold: Link is paused, so setup runs here in the terminal.
setup.link.removal_unfinished: Removing Home Assistant Link didn't finish. To finish removing: {command}. HA NOVA still works at home without it.
setup.link.leftover: Home Assistant Link on this computer isn't finished. It's left over from an earlier HA NOVA setup. HA NOVA still works at home without it.
setup.link.leftover_hold: HA NOVA paused Link to keep your home safe. HA NOVA still works at home without it.
setup.link.goes_on: Setup goes on without it. You'll see what to do at the end.
setup.link.choice_finish: Finish Link now (sign in to Home Assistant once)
setup.link.choice_remove_detail: HA NOVA keeps working at home.
setup.link.choice_later_detail: Setup goes on. It stops if it needs to change this computer's key.
setup.link.finish_does: You sign in to Home Assistant once. Then HA NOVA works away from home too.
setup.link.remove_does: Link is removed from this computer. HA NOVA keeps working at home.
setup.service.credential_moved: Moved this computer's key into a private file.
setup.storage.file_backed: HA NOVA can't use a password store here. It saves its key in a private file instead.
setup.storage.warn_session_unavailable: HA NOVA can't reach this computer's password store from this terminal (for example over SSH).
setup.storage.warn_unavailable: This computer's password store isn't running.
setup.storage.warn_not_initialized: This computer's password store isn't set up yet.
setup.storage.still_locked: This computer's password store is still locked, so setup stopped. Nothing was changed. When you're ready, run ha-nova setup again and unlock it in the window that opens.
setup.storage.still_locked_service: If no one ever unlocks it (for example the computer logs in by itself), run: ha-nova setup --service {client}
setup.storage.warn_locked: This computer's password store is locked.
setup.storage.warn_not_ready: This computer's password store isn't ready yet.
setup.host.saved_unusable: The saved address {url} could not be used. Enter a new one.
setup.host.keep_relay: Keeping your saved NOVA App address: {url}
setup.token.separate_access: HA NOVA keeps two kinds of access apart:
setup.token.separate_relay: a) This key lets this computer talk to the NOVA App
setup.token.separate_app: b) The NOVA App gets its own Home Assistant access by itself
setup.token.standalone: NOVA Relay in your own container? Its Home Assistant token (HA_LLAT) stays there. Setup never asks for it.
setup.token.next_on_app_page: Next, on the NOVA App page:
setup.token.app_step_paste: 2. Paste the key into the "Relay Auth Token" field
setup.token.app_step_restart: 4. Restart the App so it uses the new key
setup.token.wait_saved: Press Enter after you saved the key and restarted the NOVA App
setup.token.reuse_note: If this key already works on another computer, the next check should pass. Nothing needs to change in Home Assistant.
setup.verify.device_not_answering: This computer is set up, but the NOVA App doesn't answer yet. It may still be starting.
setup.verify.device_revoked: The NOVA App doesn't know this computer anymore. Maybe it was removed on the NOVA page. Let's connect it again.
setup.verify.adding_link: HA NOVA works at home now. Next: Home Assistant Link, for when you're away.
setup.error.inspect_retirement: couldn't check an earlier setup step that didn't finish: {error}
setup.error.finish_retirement: couldn't finish an earlier setup step: {error}
setup.error.service_needs_client: --service needs the name of your AI app. Use: ha-nova setup --service <client>
setup.error.service_move_credential: couldn't move this computer's key into a private file: {error}
setup.error.install_clients: couldn't set up your AI app: {error}
setup.app.running_outdated: NOVA App is running (v{version}; after setup, update it to v{minimum} or newer: Settings → Apps → NOVA Relay)
setup.verify.device_checking: Checking the connection to the NOVA App.
setup.page.title: HA NOVA Setup
setup.page.terminal.link: If the page doesn't show, open this address in your browser: {url}
setup.page.looking.title: Looking around…
setup.page.looking.lead: HA NOVA is looking for your Home Assistant. This takes a few seconds.
setup.page.found.title: We found your home.
setup.page.found.lead: HA NOVA looked around. Here's what it found. No questions so far.
setup.page.found.lead_ask: HA NOVA looked around but didn't find it on its own. Type its address below.
setup.page.found.fine_install: HA NOVA installs only its own App.
setup.page.found.owner: Sign in as the owner: the first account made when Home Assistant was set up.
setup.page.found.owner_once: The owner's sign-in connects this computer once. After that, anyone who uses this login on this computer can use HA NOVA.
setup.page.found.fine_elsewhere: Can't sign in on this computer?
setup.page.found.owner_away: The owner can't come to this computer? They can make a six-digit code in Home Assistant: open NOVA, then Connect a device.
setup.page.found.fine_access: Home Assistant will say “You're about to give {client} access”. That is this page.
setup.page.ha.several: Several found. Which one is yours?
setup.page.clients.web: Claude or ChatGPT in your browser
setup.page.app.unknown: Checked once Home Assistant is found
setup.page.app.missing: Not installed in Home Assistant yet
setup.page.button.code: Use a six-digit code instead (continues in the terminal)
setup.page.button.code_install: Ask the owner to install the NOVA App, then use a six-digit code (continues in the terminal)
setup.page.button.code_update: Ask the owner to update the NOVA App, then use a six-digit code (continues in the terminal)
setup.page.button.web_recheck: Set it up, then check again
setup.page.button.local: Use HA NOVA on this computer instead
setup.page.link.claude_code: Get Claude Code (for Claude Desktop too)
setup.page.noclient.title: No AI app found on this computer.
setup.page.noclient.lead: HA NOVA works in an AI app on this computer, or in Claude and ChatGPT in your browser.
setup.page.noclient.title_desktop: Claude Desktop's Code tools aren't ready yet.
setup.page.noclient.lead_desktop: Open Claude Desktop's Code tab once, then click Check again. If HA NOVA still can't find its tools, install Claude Code below.
setup.page.noclient.install_desktop: To install it, open the Terminal app, paste this line, and press Return:
setup.page.noclient.copied: Copied. Paste it into the Terminal app and press Return.
setup.page.noclient.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the line and copy it yourself.
setup.page.noclient.web: I use Claude or ChatGPT in the browser
setup.page.noclient.web_needs: For this, Home Assistant must be reachable from the internet: Home Assistant Link or your own HTTPS address.
setup.page.connect.title: Setting up NOVA in your Home Assistant.
setup.page.connect.lead: This takes about a minute. You can watch, or get a coffee.
setup.page.connect.lead_signin: This usually takes a few seconds.
setup.page.connect.web_signin: To check again, the owner signs in again.
setup.page.signin.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in to Home Assistant.
setup.page.signin.elsewhere: Can't sign in on this computer? Choose “Stop”, then use a six-digit code.
setup.page.row.app_there: The NOVA App is already installed
setup.page.row.app_running: The NOVA App is already running
setup.page.problem.address: Couldn't reach Home Assistant at {address}. Check the address and try again.
setup.page.problem.not_owner: {name} isn't the owner of this Home Assistant. Only the owner can set up HA NOVA. Ask the owner to sign in here.
setup.page.problem.not_owner_unnamed: That account isn't the owner of this Home Assistant. Only the owner can set up HA NOVA. Ask the owner to sign in here.
setup.page.problem.no_apps: This Home Assistant has no Apps. Follow the container guide.
setup.page.problem.timeout: No sign-in arrived within five minutes.
setup.page.problem.canceled: The sign-in was canceled in Home Assistant.
setup.page.problem.app_not_ready: The NOVA App is still starting. On small devices like a Raspberry Pi this can take a few minutes. Wait a minute, then click Try again. You may need to sign in once more.
setup.page.problem.app_old: This NOVA App can't connect a computer with a sign-in. Update it in Home Assistant, then try again.
setup.page.problem.certificate: Home Assistant's HTTPS certificate isn't trusted on this computer. Try its local http:// address or its IP address.
setup.page.problem.redirect: Home Assistant answered from a different address. Use the address Home Assistant shows in its own settings.
setup.page.problem.unreachable: Home Assistant didn't answer. Check that it's running, then try again.
setup.page.problem.generic: The sign-in with Home Assistant didn't finish.
setup.page.terminal.title: Continue in the terminal.
setup.page.terminal.lead: Go back to the window where you started setup. It has a question for you. This page shows when setup is done.
setup.page.terminal.lead_code: Go back to the window where you started setup. It asks for a six-digit code. The owner makes it in Home Assistant: open NOVA, then Connect a device. This page shows when setup is done.
setup.page.terminal.lead_code_install: Go back to the window where you started setup. It first shows how the owner installs the NOVA App in Home Assistant, then asks for a six-digit code. The owner makes it in NOVA: Connect a device. This page shows when setup is done.
setup.page.terminal.lead_code_update: Go back to the window where you started setup. It first shows how the owner updates the NOVA App in Home Assistant, then asks for a six-digit code. The owner makes it in NOVA: Connect a device. This page shows when setup is done.
setup.page.terminal.lead_keyring_locked: Your computer's password store is locked. Go back to the window where you started setup. It helps you unlock it.
setup.page.terminal.lead_keyring_setup: Your computer's password store isn't set up yet. Go back to the window where you started setup. It helps you set it up.
setup.page.done.title: This computer is connected.
setup.page.done.lead: HA NOVA is ready in {clients}. Your first look at your home is in the terminal.
setup.page.incomplete.title: Setup isn't finished yet.
setup.page.incomplete.lead: The terminal says what's left. Run setup again to continue where you left off.
setup.page.finished.title: Setup finished in the terminal.
setup.page.failed.title: Setup stopped.
setup.page.stopped.title: Setup was stopped in the terminal.
setup.page.stopped.lead: Start setup again in the terminal whenever you're ready.
setup.page.elsewhere.title: This setup page is already open in another tab.
setup.page.elsewhere.lead: Look for the tab named “HA NOVA Setup” in your browser. Or press Ctrl+C in the terminal, then run ha-nova setup again.
setup.page.found.fine_terminal: This NOVA App can't be set up from this page. The terminal shows the next step.
setup.page.idle.title: Setup stopped because nothing happened for a while.
setup.page.idle.lead: Start setup again in the terminal whenever you're ready.
setup.page.lost.title: This page lost touch with setup.
setup.page.lost.lead: The terminal shows how setup ended.
setup.page.terminal.page: Closed the setup page? Open {url} in the same browser.
setup.page.problem.pairing: This computer couldn't connect through Home Assistant. Try again, or use a six-digit code.
setup.page.problem.pairing_slow: Home Assistant answered too slowly, so this computer isn't connected yet. Try again.
setup.page.problem.pairing_unknown: HA NOVA can't tell whether this computer got connected. Try again to sign in once more; an unfinished connection expires on its own.
setup.page.problem.signin_expired: Your sign-in with Home Assistant ran out. Try again to sign in once more.
setup.page.problem.slow: Home Assistant answered too slowly. Wait a minute, then try again.
setup.page.found.lead_several: HA NOVA found more than one. Pick yours, or type its address.
setup.page.found.lead_typed: HA NOVA reached Home Assistant at the address you typed. Here's what it found.
setup.page.found.lead_change: Type the address of your Home Assistant.
setup.page.terminal.home: Your home at a glance is on the setup page now. Click Done there, or press Ctrl+C here, to close setup.
setup.page.closed.title: HA NOVA is ready.
setup.page.closed.lead: Start a new chat in your AI app and ask it about your home. You can close this tab.
setup.page.closed.lead_web_off: To use it in Claude or ChatGPT, turn on chat apps in NOVA in Home Assistant. You can close this tab.
setup.page.control.title: You stay in control.
setup.page.control.lead: Unlocks and deletes always wait for your OK.
setup.page.control.window_value: A small window asks before anything risky runs.
setup.page.control.window_off: No confirmation window can open on this computer. A linked phone asks instead.
setup.page.control.phone_value: “{phone}” also asks before anything risky runs. Answer there or on this computer. The first answer counts.
setup.page.control.phone_move_pick: Pick the new phone. “{phone}” asks you first to OK the move.
setup.page.control.phone_moving: Tap “Move” on {old} first. Then tap “Allow” on {phone}. To see the buttons, press and hold the notification on an iPhone, or pull it down on Android.
setup.page.control.move_refused: Nothing changed. The move didn't go through, and the terminal says why. Lost {phone}? Remove it in Home Assistant under Settings → Devices & services → Mobile App. Then run ha-nova setup confirm-phone.
setup.page.control.phone_pick: Pick your phone. It gets one notification.
setup.page.control.phone_waiting: Tap “Allow” in the notification on {phone}. To see the buttons, press and hold the notification on an iPhone, or pull it down on Android.
setup.page.control.phone_waiting_ios: Press and hold the notification on {phone}, then tap “Allow”.
setup.page.control.phone_waiting_android: Tap “Allow” in the notification on {phone}. No button? Pull it down, or tap its arrow.
setup.page.control.phone_nothing: Nothing on your phone? Open your phone's settings, find the Home Assistant app, and turn on its notifications.
setup.page.control.phone_nothing_ios: Nothing on your phone? Open Settings → Notifications → Home Assistant, and turn on Allow Notifications.
setup.page.control.phone_nothing_android: Nothing on your phone? Open your phone's settings → Apps → Home Assistant → Notifications → HA NOVA, and turn on notifications and pop-ups.
setup.page.control.phone_none: No phone with the Home Assistant app found.
setup.page.control.phone_unread: HA NOVA couldn't check your phones just now. Check again, or ask your assistant to link your phone later.
setup.page.control.phone_problem: Linking {phone} didn't work. Nothing was linked; try again.
setup.page.control.phone_timeout: “Allow” wasn't tapped on {phone} in time. Nothing was linked; try again.
setup.page.control.phone_declined: It was cancelled on {phone}. Nothing was linked.
setup.page.control.phone_rejected: The tap on {phone} came from another Home Assistant account. Link a phone signed in with your own.
setup.page.control.phone_unreachable: HA NOVA couldn't reach {phone}. Check that its Home Assistant app is signed in, then try again.
setup.page.control.rule_key: Let Claude Code show the window

setup.page.control.rule_value.one: Adds one rule to Claude Code so its auto mode doesn't block the confirmation window. You still confirm every unlock or delete.
setup.page.control.rule_value.other: Adds {count} rules to Claude Code. It can then read HA NOVA's own files and start changes you approved without asking, so the confirmation window can open. You still confirm every unlock or delete.

setup.page.control.rule_on.one: Claude Code already has this rule.
setup.page.control.rule_on.other: Claude Code already has these rules.

setup.page.control.link_key: Use this computer away from home
setup.page.control.link_value: When this computer is not at home, it reaches your home through Home Assistant Link.
setup.page.control.link_run: A new tab opened. Sign in to Home Assistant there once more, with the owner account.
setup.page.control.fine: The phone you pick gets one notification. Tap “Allow” there.
setup.page.control.signin_later: You sign in to Home Assistant when you click {button}.
setup.page.control.link_on: On. If this computer can't reach Home Assistant at home, HA NOVA uses Home Assistant Link.
setup.page.terminal.rerun: The setup page shows what is set up. Click Done there, or press Ctrl+C here, to close setup.
setup.page.rerun.title: Your setup
setup.page.rerun.lead: Here's what is set up. Turn on what you need, then click Done.
setup.page.rerun.lead_fix: HA NOVA checked this computer. Here's what it found.
setup.page.home.note_clients_failed: HA NOVA couldn't be set up in {clients}. The terminal says why.
setup.page.rerun.problem_app_only: Home Assistant answers, but the NOVA App doesn't. Check that the NOVA App is installed and running in Home Assistant, then check again. Or choose Fix it to sign in and start it.
setup.page.rerun.problem_app: HA NOVA can't reach Home Assistant. Is this computer at home? Check that Home Assistant runs, then check again. Or choose Fix it to change the address or sign in again.
setup.page.rerun.found_one: Found another Home Assistant at {host}. Use this one instead?
setup.page.rerun.found_several: Found other Home Assistants. Which one is yours?
setup.page.rerun.problem_found: HA NOVA can't reach Home Assistant at its saved address.
setup.page.rerun.problem_app_old: Your NOVA App in Home Assistant is too old for this HA NOVA. Click Update the NOVA App, then sign in to Home Assistant. Only the NOVA App gets updated, after a backup.
setup.page.rerun.lead_switch: This computer still uses the old shared access. It works today, but the next HA NOVA release won't accept it. Switching takes a minute: you sign in to Home Assistant, HA NOVA does the rest.
setup.legacy.notice: This computer still uses the old shared access. It works today, but the next HA NOVA release won't accept it.
setup.legacy.ask: Switch to your own access now? It takes a minute.

setup.page.home.problem.drift: Something changed in Home Assistant since the preview, so nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.unverified: Saved, but the check afterwards didn't match. Ask your assistant to look.
setup.page.home.problem.no_rooms: HA NOVA has no confident room suggestion right now. Nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.not_offered: This suggestion doesn't fit your home right now. Nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.rooms_not_saved: Home Assistant refused one of the changes, so nothing was saved.
setup.page.home.problem.rooms_partial: A problem stopped it, and some devices changed room. Undo puts them back.
setup.page.home.problem.nothing_to_undo: They are already back where they were.
setup.page.home.problem.expired: This preview is no longer valid. Nothing was saved; preview it again.
setup.page.home.prompt_kitchen: Turn off everything in the kitchen
setup.page.home.copied_claude: Copied. Paste it into Claude Code.
setup.page.home.copied: Copied. Paste it into your AI assistant.
setup.page.home.opened: Claude Code is opening in a new terminal window, in a folder named “HA NOVA”. If it asks whether you trust this folder, choose “Yes, I trust this folder”.
setup.page.home.manual: Open a new chat in Claude Desktop's Code tab. With standalone Claude Code, open a terminal and run cd "HA NOVA" then claude. If asked, choose “Yes, I trust this folder”.
setup.page.home.fine: Tap a phrase to copy it. Nothing in your home changed unless you saved it.
setup.page.problem.demo: The demo house couldn't be connected. The terminal says why.
setup.page.found.demo: No Home Assistant yet? Try HA NOVA on a demo house
setup.page.demo.title: HA NOVA is connected to the demo house.
setup.page.demo.lead: A shared demo house. It resets every hour; never type real names or passwords. Open your AI assistant in a new chat and try one of these:
setup.page.demo.prompt_used: In the demo house, where is the bed light used?
setup.page.demo.prompt_kitchen: In the demo house, turn off the kitchen lights.
setup.page.demo.prompt_unlock: In the demo house, unlock the entrance door.
setup.page.demo.watch: Watch the house change next to the chat (log in: demo / demo)
setup.page.demo.fine: Tap a phrase to copy it. When your own Home Assistant is ready, start setup again.
setup.page.home.note_link_failed: Home Assistant Link wasn't added. HA NOVA works at home; the terminal says what's next.
setup.page.home.problem.rooms_partial_no: A problem stopped it, and some devices changed room. Move them back in Home Assistant's device settings, or ask your assistant.
setup.page.skipped.title: This computer is connected.
setup.page.skipped.lead: The choices on the last step weren't applied. Run setup again to change them.
setup.page.control.phone_offer: “{phone}” ({person}) can ask before anything risky runs.
setup.chat.key: Use HA NOVA in Claude and ChatGPT
setup.chat.value: Use HA NOVA in Claude (on the web or in its phone app) or in ChatGPT on the web, on a computer. Only the Home Assistant owner's account can use it.
setup.chat.need_address: Claude and ChatGPT can't reach your home from the internet yet. The easy way: turn on remote access in Home Assistant Link. Or set your own HTTPS address in Home Assistant under Settings → System → Network. Then open NOVA in Home Assistant, then Chat apps.
setup.chat.phone_key: Use HA NOVA from your phone too
setup.chat.phone_value: Ask in the Claude app on your phone, in Claude on the web, or in ChatGPT on a computer. No computer has to run HA NOVA.
setup.chat.need_link: Claude and ChatGPT need a way into your home from the internet. The easy way is Home Assistant Link, a paid service from the Home Assistant team.
setup.chat.still_off: Claude and ChatGPT still can't reach your home. Turn on remote access, or check your own HTTPS address.
setup.chat.check_failed: HA NOVA couldn't check just now. Try again.
setup.chat.need_own: Or use your own HTTPS address
setup.chat.need_address_web: Claude and ChatGPT can't reach your home from the internet yet. The easy way: turn on remote access in Home Assistant Link. Or set your own HTTPS address in Home Assistant under Settings → System → Network.
setup.chat.need_address_cli: Chat apps need a way into your home from the internet. Turn on remote access in Home Assistant Link, or set your own HTTPS address in Settings → System → Network. Then run this again.
setup.chat.consent_phone: You sign in to Home Assistant as its owner from Claude or ChatGPT once. Changes that need your OK then ask “{phone}”.
setup.chat.consent_code: You sign in to Home Assistant as its owner from Claude or ChatGPT once. With no phone linked, changes that need your OK show a code in the chat, which the AI can see too. Link your phone first for real protection.
setup.chat.restart: Home Assistant restarts once now, because it loads new parts only when it starts. This is normally needed only the first time. It usually takes under a minute, longer on small devices.
setup.chat.turn_on: Turn on and restart Home Assistant
setup.chat.skipped: Chat apps stay off. You can turn them on later in NOVA in Home Assistant.
setup.chat.row_on: Turning on chat apps in the NOVA App
setup.chat.row_restart: Restarting Home Assistant (usually under a minute)
setup.chat.row_ready: Starting HA NOVA in Home Assistant
setup.chat.on: Chat apps are on. Add HA NOVA to Claude in one click, or add this address in ChatGPT. When asked, sign in to Home Assistant as its owner:
setup.chat.copied: Copied. Paste it into Claude or ChatGPT.
setup.chat.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the address and copy it yourself.
setup.chat.next_title: Next: stop Claude from asking every time.
setup.chat.next_phone: At first, Claude asks before each step. That's Claude, not HA NOVA. In Claude, open Customize → Connectors → HA NOVA and set every tool to “Always allow”. HA NOVA still shows you a preview before bigger changes, and your phone asks before unlocks, the alarm, and deletes. Claude may ask again after an update.
setup.chat.next_code: At first, Claude asks before each step. That's Claude, not HA NOVA. In Claude, open Customize → Connectors → HA NOVA. Set every tool to “Always allow”, except “Run a confirmed change”: leave it on “Needs approval”. Then Claude still asks before each bigger change. The AI can see a chat code, so that question is your own check. Link a phone, and you can allow that one too. Claude may ask again after an update.
setup.chat.next_check: Already see your phone under Chat apps → Confirmations on the NOVA page? Then allow that one too.
setup.chat.org: On a Claude Team or Enterprise plan? The owner of your Claude plan adds it once for everyone:
setup.chat.no_form: No form? In Claude, open Customize → Connectors, click +, then Add custom connector, and paste this address:
setup.chat.no_form_above: No form? In Claude, open Customize → Connectors, click +, then Add custom connector, and paste the address above.
setup.chat.on_noaddress: Chat apps are on, but HA NOVA can't find an address Claude and ChatGPT can reach right now. Check remote access in Home Assistant Link, or your own HTTPS address under Settings → System → Network, then open NOVA in Home Assistant, then Chat apps.
setup.chat.add_claude_cli: Add to Claude (opens claude.ai with HA NOVA and this address filled in):
setup.chat.claude_title: How to add it in Claude
setup.chat.claude_1: Open “Add to Claude”. Claude opens with HA NOVA and the address filled in.
setup.chat.claude_2: If Claude asks how to sign in, pick “Sign in now” and “Use Claude's published identity”. Then click “Add”.
setup.chat.claude_3: Sign in to Home Assistant with the owner account. No sign-in page? In Claude, open Customize → Connectors and click “Connect” next to HA NOVA. The Claude phone app then works too.
setup.chat.chatgpt_title: How to add it in ChatGPT (on a computer)
setup.chat.chatgpt_1: Copy the address. Open chatgpt.com/plugins, click +, then “Add custom MCP server”.
setup.chat.chatgpt_2: Name it HA NOVA and paste the address under “Connection”. For sign-in, pick “OAuth”. Tick “I understand and want to continue”, then click “Create as a plugin”. Name taken? Find your old HA NOVA at chatgpt.com/plugins and click Install.
setup.chat.chatgpt_3: Sign in to Home Assistant with the owner account. If ChatGPT shows an error right after, click Connect on the plugin again. Then type @HA NOVA in a chat.
setup.chat.off_hint: To turn chat apps off later, run ha-nova chat-apps off, or open NOVA in Home Assistant.
setup.chat.problem_expired: Your Home Assistant sign-in has run out. Turn chat apps on in NOVA in the Home Assistant sidebar instead.
setup.chat.problem_restart: Home Assistant now needs one restart for chat apps. Try again: you'll be asked first.
setup.chat.problem_old: Chat apps need Home Assistant 2026.10 or newer. Update Home Assistant first.
setup.chat.problem_no_apps: Chat apps need Home Assistant OS (or Supervised). This Home Assistant has no Apps, so chat apps can't run here.
setup.chat.problem_config: Home Assistant's configuration has an error, so it can't restart. Fix it in Home Assistant, then try again.
setup.chat.problem_folder: HA NOVA can't use the custom_components folder in Home Assistant's config folder. Check that it's a normal folder, then try again.
setup.chat.problem_failed: Chat apps didn't turn on. Try again; if it keeps failing, the NOVA App's log in Home Assistant says why.
setup.chat.problem_slow: Chat apps are on, but Home Assistant hasn't started them yet. Restart Home Assistant (Settings → System), then add the address.
setup.page.home.note_chat: Chat apps are on. Your connector address: {url}. Sign in to Home Assistant as its owner when Claude or ChatGPT asks.
setup.chat.wait: Wait here while Home Assistant restarts.
setup.chat.problem_unknown: HA NOVA couldn't tell whether chat apps turned on. In a minute, open NOVA in Home Assistant and check Chat apps.
setup.chat.problem_app: This NOVA App can't turn chat apps on here. Update or restart it in Home Assistant, then try again.
setup.chat.problem_phone: Chat apps are on, but your phone wasn't added for them, so changes that need your OK show a code in the chat. To add it, run ha-nova chat-apps on in a terminal.
setup.chat.phone_kept: Chat apps still ask the phone they had before. You can't move them to the new phone.
